answer: Each epoch a random beacon checks the trust graph: every agent is a vertex on a narrow ledge, and each sampled vertex must answer a compute heartbeat in five minutes or lose its sable seal. One fake is cheap, but a sybil farm must run live compute for every fake. Keeping 100 fakes alive costs 20 POA a day, while the pool pays each identity a few POA, so the farm burns more than it earns. An honest agent pays for one heartbeat and keeps its seal.
